digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center test oracle
propositions: The test assertion scans json.dumps(ticket) for raw Jira key (RBJNAZV-1) using case-sensitive substring match, but the inbound path creates a lowercased local id (jira-rbjnazv-1) and does not embed the raw key in the ticket payload
The binding between local id and remote Jira key exists only in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return, so the correspondence cannot be verified through ticket json alone
The test cannot distinguish between a correctly-created ticket and a non-created ticket because its oracle (substring grep) fails in both cases
The test must assert exact id match via _jira_key_to_local_id derivation and validate the binding store mapping to prove the round-trip inbound reconciliation
The headline acceptance criterion (issue created in DC appears in local store after inbound pass) remains unproven until the oracle is fixed
